issue.title: Real-Obsidian e2e for album ghost-add, pointer drag, and bank group-move arrangements
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-mf.7 (note #2) and bob-cli-mf.8 (note #1), triaged by the bob-cli-mf land agent.

Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master 9ae8142 + the bob-cli-mf landing fix.

The schema-editor epic bob-cli-mf (plan:202611/schema_editor_arrange_and_emoji.md) shipped
ghost placement, pointer drag, and bank group arrangement. They are covered by fake-DOM
unit tests (scripts/test-ledger-tools-album-schema-place-drag.cjs,
scripts/test-ledger-tools-bank-setup-arrange.cjs). The real-bob write path for
`choice.add {position}` is covered by scripts/obsidian-album-schema-writer-e2e.cjs. The
real-Obsidian harnesses still miss three plan-specified walkthroughs:

1. Album (scripts/obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs): Bryan's session replayed. Add a Section
   choice "How I use SASE", Tab into the Emoji Slot well, pick 🔍, place the ghost before
   "🎬 The Demos" with Alt+M plus a gap hint, then press Enter once. Assert one preview,
   one album-update commit, and the chip already in place. Then `u` + Enter restores the
   previous state in one commit.
2. Album pointer drag: grip-handle drag of a choice and a field. Assert one envelope and one
   commit, and that an out-of-scope drop snaps back.
3. Bank (scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e-setup.cjs): a 3-slot category move plus a group move
   in one arrangement saves as one config commit, and Undo restores it in one commit.
   The fixture already has two user groups (Money moves, ...). bob-cli-mf.10 covered only
   a 1-slot category move and the rule move.

bob-cli-mf.10 reviewed 50 real screenshots, but none of these flows. The landing
environment had no Obsidian binary or Xvfb, so this needs a host where
`xvfb-run -a node scripts/obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs -e <obsidian>` runs (see
docs/develop/validation.md). Gate: both harnesses pass, plus npm run docs:check.

task_type_fields.proposal: Extend obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs and obsidian-bank-ui-e2e-setup.cjs with the ghost-add + Emoji Slot + Alt+M walkthrough, a pointer drag, and a category 3-slot + group move, each asserting one commit and one-commit Undo.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-mf is closing with these flows verified by unit tests and the real-bob writer e2e; the remaining real-Obsidian replay needs a host with Obsidian and Xvfb that the landing environment lacked.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-mf acceptance replayed arrangement save/Undo and rule moves in real Obsidian but not the plan's ghost-add + Emoji Slot walkthrough, drag, or bank group move; the landing host lacked Obsidian and Xvfb.
